name: What kind of projects in Berkeley require significant plumbing and electrical coordination?

mainEntity.name: What kind of projects in Berkeley require significant plumbing and electrical coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any project involving new construction, major remodels, or significant system upgrades will require extensive plumbing and electrical coordination in Berkeley and surrounding East Bay areas. This includes bathroom and kitchen renovations, home additions, basement finishing, and commercial build-outs. These projects often involve relocating existing utilities or installing new ones, making careful planning essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction, major remodels, and system upgrades in Berkeley and East Bay require significant coordination.
